📜 Booking & Refund Policy

GRIEVANCE REDRESSAL

Any complaint about a booking, a listing or your data can be sent to our Grievance Officer.
Email: grievance@ho-om.in
General support: support@ho-om.in
Helpline (WhatsApp): +91 91832 06742
Grievance Officer: Ankit Kumar Dewangan, Compliance & Grievance Officer
Reply within: 24–48 hours  ·  Resolved within: 15 business days
HOSTEL OM-F, Shanti Vihar Colony, Daganiya, behind CSEB Office, Raipur, Chhattisgarh – 492013

1. Booking Confirmation: Your booking is confirmed only once full payment or the required advance amount has been paid.

2. Cancellation & Refund:
- The amount you pay here is HostelOM's booking fee, charged on top of the hostel's own rent. It is non-refundable if you cancel, change plan, arrive late, or do not turn up — on every plan, at any notice.
- Cancelling releases your bed for someone else. It does not return the booking fee.
- The hostel's rent and food charges are paid at the hostel and are governed by that hostel's own policy, not ours.

2a. When you DO get 100% back:
- The hostel cancels your booking before check-in.
- You reach on time but the bed you paid for is not available — the hostel is shut, the bed was given to someone else, or it was double-booked.
Report it to support on +91 91832 06742 before taking any other bed. Approved refunds start within 48 hours and reach your account in 5–7 working days.

3. Security Deposit & Notice Period:
- Any security deposit, and the notice you must give before vacating, are set by the hostel itself — typically 15 to 30 days' notice, and the deposit returned if the room is left in the same condition.
- These are the hostel's own terms. HostelOM neither collects nor holds the deposit and is not a party to it. Please confirm them with the hostel before you check in.

1. बुकिंग की पुष्टि: आपकी बुकिंग तभी पक्की मानी जाएगी जब आप पूरी राशि या आवश्यक अग्रिम राशि (एडवांस) का भुगतान कर देंगे।

2. रद्दीकरण और वापसी:
- यहाँ जो राशि आप देते हैं, वह HostelOM का बुकिंग शुल्क है, जो हॉस्टल के अपने किराये के ऊपर जुड़ता है। वह वापस नहीं होती — किसी भी प्लान में, कितना भी पहले रद्द करें, या बिना बताए न आने पर।
- रद्द करने से आपका बेड किसी और के लिए खाली हो जाता है। बुकिंग शुल्क वापस नहीं आता।
- हॉस्टल का किराया और खाने का शुल्क हॉस्टल में दिया जाता है और उस पर उसी हॉस्टल की नीति लागू होगी, हमारी नहीं।

2क. पूरा पैसा कब वापस मिलता है:
- हॉस्टल खुद चेक-इन से पहले बुकिंग रद्द कर दे।
- आप समय पर पहुँचें और जिस बेड का पैसा दिया वह ना मिले — हॉस्टल बंद हो, बेड किसी और को दे दिया हो, या दोहरी बुकिंग हो गई हो।
कोई दूसरा बेड लेने से पहले +91 91832 06742 पर बताइये। मंजूर होने पर 48 घंटे में वापसी शुरू, 5–7 कार्यदिवस में खाते में।

3. मासिक ठहराव और जमा राशि:
- सुरक्षा जमा राशि (सिक्योरिटी डिपॉज़िट) तभी वापस होगी जब कमरा चेक-इन जैसी स्थिति में वापस किया जाएगा।
- कमरा खाली करने से कम से कम 15-30 दिन पहले सूचना देना ज़रूरी है।

4. दैनिक/साप्ताहिक ठहराव:
- अग्रिम राशि (एडवांस) वापस नहीं की जाएगी।

📋 Booking & Cancellation Policy

            

                
1. Booking Fee: You pay HostelOM's booking fee now, through the app. This reserves your bed. The hostel's own rent and food charges are not paid here — you pay those directly at the hostel on arrival.

                
2. Balance at Hostel: The remaining amount is paid directly to the hostel/owner at check-in — HostelOM is not involved in that payment.

                
3. Non-Refundable: If you cancel, change your plan, arrive late or don't turn up, the advance is not refunded — and there are no partial refunds. This is the same for every plan:

                
    
                    
  • 📅 Daily Plan — advance non-refundable
    • 
                    
  • 🗓️ Weekly Plan — advance non-refundable
    • 
                    
  • 📆 Monthly Plan — advance non-refundable
    • 
                

                
4. No-show: If you don't check in without cancelling, your booking is automatically cancelled and the bed released to other guests — the advance stays forfeited.

                
5. When you get 100% back: If the hostel cancels before check-in, or you reach on time and the bed you paid for is not available (hostel shut, bed given to someone else, or double-booked) — your full advance is refunded. Call +91 91832 06742 before taking any other bed. Refund starts within 48 hours and reaches you in 5–7 working days.
